Name: Demi's Genshin Impact Hair
Author: Demiistar
Description:
A hairstyle for Fashion Sense that lets you have the hair of various characters from Genshin Impact. Still a work in progress and being updated occassionally.

Currently includes:
[list]
[*]Kazuha (Has been updated)
[*]Xiao

[*]Venti (Animated)
[/list]
⬇️‼️ Download Fashiuon Sense here (REQUIRED!!!!) ‼️⬇️
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969

NOTICE: If you have downloaded the old version of Kazuha's hair and wish to use the new one please delete the old one! If you have both installed neither will appear in the Fashion Sense menu!

Downloads.Description: There was previously an issue with Kazuha's hair covering up the player head, but I have fixed it.
